deep_dive.title: Toward Multi-kW Power Delivery Methodologies for Advanced 3D Heterogeneous Integration
deep_dive.abstract: The demands of modern applications require the construction of ever more complex integrated systems, with AI applications in particular serving as a significant driver for increased system size, potentially going beyond the trilliontransistor mark. The path to building these systems requires the use of advanced packaging, with heterogeneous integrated 2D and 3D chiplets placed atop a substrate. Such computationally powerful systems require significant power for computation: reliable and robust power delivery is a major challenge in light of high power densities and pin count bottlenecks. This paper overviews approaches to building design methodologies that overcome this problem, through the design of multistage distributed power delivery systems, optimized for performance and reliability, and built to coexist within stringent performance, thermal, and reliability constraints.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Advanced 3D heterogeneous integration with chiplets faces severe power delivery challenges from high power density and pin-count bottlenecks. This paper surveys design methodologies for multistage distributed power delivery networks in multi-kW systems.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 面向AI等应用驱动的超大规模3D异构集成系统，芯片放置在基板上并以高功率密度运行，可靠供电因功耗密度高和引脚数量瓶颈而成为重大挑战。本文综述并构建多级分布式供电网络的设计方法学，以支撑多千瓦级系统的电源配送。该工作为先进封装下的供电与电源完整性设计提供了系统性的方法框架，对3D Chiplet集成的PDN设计具有重要参考价值。

deep_dive.title: Advanced 400G-SerDes Modulations and Equalizers for GPU Cluster in AI Era
deep_dive.abstract: High-speed GPU cluster interconnects are evolving from 200 to 400 Gbps to meet the growing computing demands of artificial intelligence. We investigate high-order modulation and advanced equalization for 400 Gbps interconnects. Theoretical bit error rate (BER) expressions for 4/8-ary pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) and approximate expressions for six PAM6 formats generated from 32-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (32QAM) are derived. In additive white Gaussian noise, PAM6 generated by framed-cross 32QAM achieves the best BER performance among the PAM6 formats. PAM6 and PAM8 incur peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) penalties of approximately 4.2 and 7.2 dB, respectively, relative to PAM4 at the KP4 forward error correction (KP4-FEC) limit. Simulations compare PAM4, PAM6, and PAM8 at a line rate of 440 Gbps (net rate of 400G) under different bandwidth limitations. As bandwidth becomes more constrained, bandwidth requirements increasingly dominate performance over noise tolerance. PAM4 requires the lowest PSNR to reach the KP4-FEC limit in mildly bandwidth-limited channels, whereas PAM6 performs best under moderate limitations. PAM8 offers a significant advantage under severe limitations because of its lower bandwidth requirement and reduced susceptibility to high-frequency attenuation. With maximum likelihood sequence estimation, PAM6 and PAM8 reach the KP4-FEC limit under all evaluated channel conditions, while PAM6 requires a lower PSNR in most channels, highlighting its potential for 400G-SerDes systems.

Simulations show framed-cross 32QAM PAM6 achieves the best BER, with PAM6 and PAM8 paying 4.2 and 7.2 dB PSNR penalties versus PAM4 at the KP4-FEC limit.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对AI时代GPU集群互连从200Gbps向400Gbps演进带来的高速信道挑战，本文研究了400Gbps链路的高阶调制与均衡方案。作者推导了PAM4、PAM8以及由32QAM生成的六种PAM6格式的误码率理论表达式，并在加性高斯白噪声信道下进行仿真比较。结果表明由framed-cross 32QAM生成的PAM6误码性能最佳，PAM6与PAM8在KP4-FEC门限处相对PAM4分别付出约4.2dB和7.2dB的PSNR代价。该工作为高速SerDes调制格式选型与均衡器设计提供了理论依据。
